page.title: Import from Excel
page.description: Load data from Excel files and download your lists.

howTo.title: How it works
howTo.step1: Download the template and fill it in.
howTo.step2: Upload the file. Nothing is saved yet: you see the check result first.
howTo.step3: Fix errors in the file and upload it again, or confirm the valid rows.
howTo.order: Suggested order: counterparties, fields, feed, animals, then expenses. Uploading a file twice is safe: existing records are not duplicated.

page.locked: You do not have access to this template. Ask your manager.
page.maxRows: Up to {{max}} rows per file. Excel (.xlsx) or CSV.
page.noAccess: You do not have import or export access
page.noAccessHint: Ask the farm manager if you need it.

job.title: Check result: {{template}}
job.hasErrors: These rows will not be imported. Fix them in the file and upload it again. If you confirm the valid rows now, they will not be doubled when you upload again.
job.confirmText: {{count}} rows will be added to the system.
job.discardText: Nothing has been saved. You can upload the file again later.
job.nothing: There is nothing new to import. Every row is already in the system or has an error.
job.doneSkipped: {{count}} rows were already there and were skipped.
job.doneErrors: {{count}} rows were not imported because of errors. Fix them and upload again.
job.donePending: {{count}} expenses are waiting for approval: they reach the reports once another person approves them.

history.emptyHint: Your history appears here after the first upload.

exports.title: Download your lists
exports.description: Lists follow your permissions: columns you cannot see are left out of the file.

entityHint.animals: Every animal in the registry, including those that have left
entityHint.fields: Active fields with the current crop

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields, crops and autumn sowing data.
fields.note: When a crop is given, a season plan is created for the field too. The season follows from the sowing date, and is created if it does not exist.

number.label: Field number
number.hint: The field's number or short code. It must not repeat.

areaHa.label: Area (ha)
areaHa.hint: In hectares. When coordinates are given, the area is computed from them.

sowingDate.label: Sowing date
sowingDate.hint: For example 25.10.2026. A past date counts as sown, a future date as planned.

coordinates.label: Coordinates (optional)
coordinates.hint: Boundary points as latitude and longitude: 39.5, 64.8; 39.5, 64.81; 39.51, 64.81

animals.title: Animals
animals.description: Tagged animals with pregnancy and purchase details.
animals.note: When a pregnancy date is given, the expected lambing date is calculated automatically. The category follows from sex and age: under one year is a lamb, older is an ewe or a ram.

birth.label: Birth date or age
birth.hint: A date (15.03.2023) or an age (3, 3 years, 18 months). With an age, the date is marked as estimated.

pregnancyDate.label: Pregnancy date
pregnancyDate.hint: The mating date. The lambing date is calculated from it.

seller.label: Seller
seller.hint: If not in the system, a new counterparty is created.

herd.label: Herd
herd.hint: Optional. A new name creates a herd. If empty and the farm has one herd, the animal joins it.

feed.title: Feed stock
feed.note: Each row enters the warehouse as an opening balance. A new feed given in tons is stored in kilograms, because rations are calculated in kilograms.

item.label: Feed
item.hint: If not in the system, a new item is created.

price.label: Price (per unit)
price.hint: In so'm, for the chosen unit.

employees.title: Employees
employees.note: An employee is identified by phone, or without one by name and hire date.

rate.label: Pay rate
rate.hint: In so'm: the monthly, daily or seasonal rate.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Must not repeat when there is no inventory number.

status.label: Status
status.hint: If empty, it counts as working.

name.label: Name
name.hint: The name of the organisation or person.

bank.label: Bank details
bank.hint: In one cell: bank name, account number, MFO.

expenses.title: Opening expenses
expenses.description: Spending made before the platform went live.
expenses.note: Large amounts wait for another person's approval, as usual. Feed, seed, fertilizer and fuel on the general farm center count as stock purchases, so they are not counted twice. Choose a field or herd for a direct cost. Animal purchases go into the animal's cost, investments into assets.

paymentMethod.label: Payment method
paymentMethod.hint: Cash, bank, card or on credit. The account is the first one of that type.

costCenter.label: Cost center
costCenter.hint: A field number, herd, machine or general farm.

budget.title: Budget 2026/27
budget.description: The plan by month and category.
budget.note: A new amount for a month and category replaces the old one.

workbook.step1: 1. Fill in the table on the first sheet. Columns with a star are required.
workbook.step2: 2. You can keep or delete the example row: it is never imported.
workbook.step3: 3. Do not change the headers. The order of columns does not matter.
workbook.step4: 4. Write dates like 25.10.2026 and numbers as usual. Latin and Cyrillic both work.
workbook.step5: 5. Upload the file to the platform. Every row is checked and errors are shown before anything is saved.
workbook.exampleMark: ← This is an example. It is not imported.
workbook.notInList: This value is not in the list. It will be checked on upload.

errors.NOT_A_SPREADSHEET: This is not an Excel or CSV file. Download the template and fill that in.
errors.OLD_EXCEL_FORMAT: This is the old .xls format. Save it as .xlsx in Excel and upload it again.
errors.FILE_TOO_COMPLEX: This file is too large to read. Remove any sheets you do not need.
errors.FST_REQ_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file must not exceed 15 MB.
errors.WRONG_TEMPLATE: The headers in this file do not match the "{{expected}}" template. Download it and fill that in.
errors.LOOKS_LIKE_OTHER_TEMPLATE: This file looks like the "{{detected}}" template, but you chose "{{expected}}".
errors.MISSING_COLUMNS: The file is missing these columns: {{columns}}.
errors.NO_DATA_ROWS: The file has no data rows. It may hold only the example.
errors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: A file can hold up to {{max}} rows and this one has {{found}}. Split it into parts.
errors.JOB_NOT_OPEN: This import has already been finished.
errors.NOTHING_TO_IMPORT: There are no valid rows to import.
